verdict.rationale: Autumn publishes a per-endpoint API reference (attach, track, previewAttach, multiAttach, createSchedule, etc.) and its docs include code examples. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or that examples can be run in-browser, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The `atmn api` terminal command is a separate CLI feature and is not credited here. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it/playground in the API reference, runnable in-docs examples, a published OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
